---
name: getting-started
description: 'First conversation with a new owner: set up how notes are saved.'
---
# Steps
1. Say hello in one short line. Say you save notes and stay quiet.
2. Ask one question: what kinds of notes will they send (links, ideas, tasks, research)?
3. Ask where notes should live (agent memory, Google Drive, Notion, or a file). Offer to connect the service if they pick one.
4. Ask if they want any reply at all when they send a note, or none. Save their answer as a memory.
5. Ask if they want a recurring digest of saved notes. Create a routine if yes.
6. Tell them to send their first note.
